mathematical_contract.frame: The cusp circle center C and unit diameter normal Nc are rational functions of one retained cusp root alpha with shared denominator Dc.
mathematical_contract.parallel: For analytic parallel Q=P+eN at parameter beta, source tangent numerator H, squared speed S=H dot H, and common denominator DcW, delta=P-C is retained without evaluating sqrt(S).
mathematical_contract.circle_projection: Writing the circle residual as R+K/sqrt(S), the complete polynomial candidate equation is R^2 S-K^2=0. Every candidate is replayed against the unsquared expression, so the opposite normal branch is never promoted.
mathematical_contract.half_selection: Both the selected-half and diameter-side expressions are represented as A+B/sqrt(S). Their exact sign uses term signs and, only when they oppose, the sign of A^2 S-B^2 in the correlated local field.
mathematical_contract.tangent: The circle/parallel tangent cross reduces to -turn*(Q-C) dot H times the exact analytic-parallel derivative-scale sign; the normal contribution vanishes by orthogonality.
mathematical_contract.parameter_map: The normalized diameter coordinate equals (1-2u)/((1-u)^2+u^2), which is strictly decreasing on [0,1]. Exact radical-sign comparison therefore orders each correlated contact against rational u and bisects a certified bracket without constructing another algebraic tower.
mathematical_contract.degeneracy: An identically zero squared radical projection is explicit DegenerateProjection unless the exact rational fast path proves a true coincident circle. It is not silently promoted to overlap.
mathematical_contract.policy: STRICT accepts exact signs and local-field counts only. APPROXIMATE_512 follows the same graph and may terminate only through the configured 512-bit predicate boundary, which records consumption.
